headline: Trump backs return of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang
standfirst: The US president joined Silicon Valley leaders calling for the AI executive's

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: President Trump publicly supported the push to bring Jensen Huang back as CEO of Nvidia.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: Silicon Valley heavyweights have been lobbying for Huang to return to the top role.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: Trump stated he believes Huang has learned a big lesson, signaling potential political support.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Watch for any formal moves by Nvidia's board or further statements from the White House.

caption:
President Trump has expressed support for the reinstatement of Jensen Huang as the chief executive of Nvidia.

The president joined a growing group of tech industry figures pushing for the return of the AI leader. He noted that he believes the executive has learned a significant lesson.
